citation: Garet, M. S., Wayne, A. J., Stancavage, F., Taylor, J., Eaton, M., Walters, K., Song, M., Brown, S., Hurlburt, S., Zhu, P., Sepanik, S., & Doolittle, F. (2011). Middle school mathematics professional development impact study: Findings after the second year of implementation (NCEE 2011-4024). Washington, DC: U.S. Department of Education, Institute of Education Sciences, National Center for Education Evaluation and Regional Assistance.
design: School-level cluster RCT (schools randomized within district blocks); 7th-grade mathematics (rational numbers PD); second-year (two-year-district) student impact sample = 39 schools (20 treatment, 19 control), 2,132 students (1,083 T, 1,049 C). Single TPD arm vs business-as-usual control.
problems: Report gives Cohen's-d-style effect sizes (impact / control-group SD) rather than Hedges' g; I applied the small-sample J correction (J=0.9796 using df = n_clusters - 2 = 37) and standardized the model-based impact SE by the same control-group SD to obtain g and g_se. The report does NOT publish an ICC for student achievement (only an MDES of 0.20), but the impacts come from a 3-level multilevel model that already accounts for clustering, so cluster_adjusted=true and no central ICC correction is needed; icc is left null (not reported). The NWEA 'Total Score' overlaps the two subscales (Fractions/Decimals, Ratio/Proportion), so the three rows are not independent.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Intensive math PD (institutes + seminars + coaching) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: NWEA Rational Number Test - Total Score
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring Y2 (end of second/final year of implementation)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report ES = impact/SD = -0.07/14.27 = -0.0049 (d); g = J*d with J=1-3/(4*37-1)=0.9796; g_se = J*(impact_se/SD) = 0.9796*(0.99/14.27). Standardized by control-group SD (14.27) from the first-year impact sample, per table notes.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.42 Table 3-4 (End of Second Year panel); also Table 4-3 (main estimate highlighted) and Table D-9
effect_sizes.notes: Main model: 3-level HLM controlling for random-assignment block and school- and student-level covariates (NWEA pretest used). Reported effect size -0.01, p=0.94, not significant. First-year wave (two-year districts, Table 3-4 top panel): impact=-0.13, SE=0.95, d=-0.0091, g=-0.0089, g_se=0.0652. Standardizing SD (control group, first-year sample) = 14.27.
